_comment: The game's own settings. Every mod may have a game.json next to its mod.json: it goes over the mods' before it
key by key, so a mod names only what it changes. See docs/modding.md, "game.json".
title: the game's name, the window's title.
garage: the garage the game is played from: a mod's garages/<id>, else Assetto Corsa's showroom of that id (the core's
garage when none says; a setting names its own in its game.json).
language: the language of the files directly in the mods' text folders, played in when the player picks none.
Another language is a folder of that name in text (text/es), picked in Settings.
locale: how the game writes what the player reads. culture: a .NET culture name (en-US, ja-JP, de-DE) for numbers
and dates. money: the currency's symbol, whether it goes after the amount, a space between, and the decimals shown;
amounts are in the game's own currency (a yen game writes yen in its rules), nothing is converted. units: imperial
(mph, miles, gallons, quarts, F, lb) or metric (km/h, km, litres, C, kg): the game's, the player may pick the other
in Settings. The words of each unit are text pools (unit.mph).
